eps.o: Blair Davenport challenges Lyra Valkyria for the NXT Women's Title. Trick Williams defends his No. 1 Contendership against Grayson Waller.
The 2024 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic begins. OTM challenge Tony D'Angelo & Channing "Stacks" Lorenzo for the NXT Tag Team Titles.
A No. 1 Contender emerges from an innovative 20-Woman Battle Royal. The first round of the 2024 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic concludes.
Trick Williams clashes with Josh Briggs. Baron Corbin & Bron Breakker battle Axiom & Nathan Frazer in Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic action.
Trick Melo Gang battle The LWO in the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic Semifinal. Jacy Jayne comes up with a way to save Chase U.
Carmelo Hayes explains his betrayal and vicious attack on Trick Williams. NXT Champion Ilja Dragunov gets more than he bargained for.
Bron Breakker & Baron Corbin challenge The D'Angelo Family for the NXT Tag Team Championship. Carmelo Hayes tangles with Joe Gacy.
Oba Femi puts the NXT North American Title on the line against Lexis King. NXT Women's Champion Lyra Valkyria answers Shotzi's challenge.
Ilja Dragunov comes face-to-face with Carmelo Hayes. Noam Dar defends the NXT Heritage Cup against a member of No Quarter Catch Crew.
NXT Superstars encounter one final roadblock before NXT Stand & Deliver. Tony D'Angelo takes on Carmelo Hayes for an NXT Title opportunity.
Trick Williams makes his triumphant return to NXT. Brooks Jensen challenges Oba Femi for the NXT North American Championship.
Trick Williams contends with Noam Dar. Riley Osborne challenges for the NXT Heritage Cup against a member of No Quarter Catch Crew.
Alpha Academy battle NXT Tag Team Champions Bron Breakker & Baron Corbin. NXT Champion Ilja Dragunov encounters Channing "Stacks" Lorenzo.
Trick Williams and Carmelo Hayes face off ahead of NXT Stand & Deliver. Tony D'Angelo has an invitation for NXT Champion Ilja Dragunov.
The Superstars of NXT usher in a new era after NXT Stand & Deliver. Trick Williams sets his sights on NXT Champion Ilja Dragunov.
Trick Williams battles Carmelo Hayes in a Steel Cage Match. NXT Champion Ilja Dragunov holds an Open Challenge.
Trick Williams must leave NXT if he cannot defeat Ilja Dragunov. Roxanne Perez defends the NXT Women's Title in a Triple Threat Match.
NXT goes Spring Breakin' one more time. Lola Vice and Natalya go to war in the first-ever Women's NXT Underground Match.
NXT Champion Trick Williams guests on "Supernova Sessions." Chelsea Green challenges Roxanne Perez. Wes Lee makes his in-ring return.
Tony D'Angelo challenges Charlie Dempsey. NXT Women's North American Championship Ladder Match qualifying bouts begin.
Natalya & Karmen Petrovic tangle with Shayna Baszler & Lola Vice. A Triple Threat Match determines Oba Femi's No. 1 Contender.
Roxanne Perez finds out her opponent for NXT Battleground is a real knockout. Sexyy Red unveils the NXT Women's North American Title.
Ethan Page makes his demands known for signing with NXT. TNA Knockouts Champion Jordynne Grace grapples with Stevie Turner.
Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes makes a big announcement regarding NXT Champion Trick Williams. Je'Von Evans collides with Shawn Spears.
Trick Williams' next challenger emerges from an impactful Battle Royal. Michin challenges NXT Women's North American Champion Kelani Jordan.
The NXT Title picture takes shape as potential challengers stake their claim. NXT Champion Trick Williams and Shawn Spears square up.
Four Superstars sign the contract for the NXT Title match at NXT Heatwave. Jaida Parker throws down with Michin in a Street Fight.
Ethan Page celebrates his NXT Championship win. Lexis King challenges Tony D'Angelo for the NXT Heritage Cup. Wes Lee ponders his future.
Ethan Page makes his first NXT Title defense. The Rascalz reunite. Duke Hudson challenges Oba Femi for the NXT North American Championship.
Brooks Jensen goes to war with former friend Josh Briggs. Cedric Alexander shows Trick Williams that his kindness is not weakness.
NXT hosts The Great American Bash. Thea Hail challenges Roxanne Perez for the NXT Women's Championship. Joe Hendry live in concert.
NXT Great American Bash continues. MSK challenge Nathan Frazier & Axiom for the NXT Tag Team Title. Ethan Page defends his NXT Title.

Wes Lee addresses the NXT Universe following his shocking betrayal of The Rascalz. Chase U challenges Nathan Frazer and Axiom. Otis steps up to answer North American Champion Oba Femi’s open challenge, and Tony D’Angelo defends the NXT Heritage Cup against Charlie Dempsey.
No. 1 Contenders emerge from a Triple Threat Match and a Gauntlet Eliminator for the NXT and NXT Women's Championships.
Joe Hendry performs live in concert. Wendy Choo summons an unexpected opponent for NXT Women's North American Champion Kelani Jordan.
Multiple Superstars cut Roxanne Perez's celebration short. Trick Williams and Pete Dunne brawl all over the WWE Performance Center.
Giulia makes her NXT in-ring debut against Chelsea Green; Plus, Trick Williams and Pete Dunne face off in a Last Man Standing Match!
Trick Williams and Ethan Page make their Championship rematch official; CM Punk arrives at NXT!
The Grayson Waller Effect hosts special guests Frazer & Axiom; Plus, a press conference ahead of NXT’s first ever show on The CW!
NXT travels to Chicago for its CW premiere. Trick Williams challenges NXT Champion Ethan Page with Special Guest Referee CM Punk.
Randy Orton returns to his hometown of St. Louis to battle Je'Von Evans. Tony D'Angelo challenges NXT North American Champion Oba Femi.
Wes Lee, Je'Von Evans and Ethan Page compete in a No. 1 Contender's Triple Threat Match. Stephanie Vaquer makes her NXT in-ring debut.
Giulia & Stephanie Vaquer team up for the first time ever to take on Fatal Influence. Trick Williams and Ethan Page come face-to-face.
The fallout from Halloween Havoc. Zaria makes her NXT in-ring debut. Lexis King challenges NXT Heritage Cup Champion Charlie Dempsey
NXT emanates from the former ECW Arena in Philadelphia. Trick Williams & WWE Hall of Famer Bubba Ray Dudley face Ethan Page & Ridge Holland.
The Iron Survivor Challenge Qualifiers begin. Kelani Jordan looks to reclaim the NXT Women's North American Title from Fallon Henley.
Andre Chase battles Ridge Holland with Chase U and an NXT Title opportunity at stake. The Iron Survivor Challenge Qualifiers continue.
NXT Women's North American Champion Fallon Henley takes on Tatum Paxley. Shawn Spears challenges Tony D'Angelo for the North American Title.
Ridge Holland confronts NXT Champion Trick Williams. Two Last Chance Iron Survivor Qualifying Matches settle who advances to Deadline.
The fallout from Deadline. The Iron Survivor Challenge winners address the NXT Universe. Je'Von Evans goes one-on-one with Wes Lee.
NXT takes the show on the road to Lowell, Mass., as Eddy Thorpe challenges Trick Williams for the NXT Title. Axiom pulls double duty.
NXT Superstars compete in a Christmas Chaos Fatal 4-Way Tag Team Match. Lexis King challenges NXT Heritage Cup Champion Charlie Dempsey.
